paragraphs.text: Kolbjörn was the Elder Druid of Fyndhorn during the Ice Age on Dominaria .

Kolbjörn was a tall man with a long, white beard. He bore the crescent mark of the Elder Druid and grew older than any Elder Druid before him. He wore flowing, crystalline blue robes and carried a gnarled wooden staff.

Kolbjörn married Disa and left Kjeldor to live among the elves in Fyndhorn forest some time before 2934 AR . That year, he traveled to Mikkel to meet ten-year-old Kaysa , ward of the village's priest, Halvor Arenson , and who bore the mark of the Elder Druid. Joining with Disa, Lucilde Fiksdotter , and Klazina Jansdotter , Kolbjörn argued with Arenson over Kaysa's fate.

Their argument was interrupted when the door was opened again by Avram Garrisson , a knight of the Order of Stromgald . Lucilde and Klazina were relieved to know that another knight had arrived to help them, until Avram revealed that he had allied himself with Lim-Dul, becoming undead, because he thought that Kjeldorans had become unworthy, allying themselves with elves and dwarfs . When the hordes of the dead villagers broke into the church, Lucilde and Klazina, with the help of Disa, started to fight against them. Even Halvor fought against the dead, creating a disk of sunlight which he used to destroy the enemies. When the situation was hopeless, he realized that Kolbjörn and Kaysa were chanting the song of Freyalise . With the magic of the goddess, all the undead were stripped of their unholy life, thus saving the group. The next morning, Halvor confirmed that the villagers of Mikkel were dead. Kaysa announced to the priest that she would be heading with Kolbjörn to Fyndhorn, and Halvor, admitting the miracle he witnessed the night before, agreed to let them go. Kaysa was thereafter raised as the couple's adopted daughter.
